text_simplified: The text discusses the importance of tarbiyah (upbringing) of children upon Islamic values and noble akhlaq (character), citing noble Prophetic hadiths. It highlights the necessity of teaching children patience, obedience, and respect, with emphasis on the role of parents in guidance and being a good example. It also clarifies that sound tarbiyah is based on both love and firmness together.

review_defects.arabic: أهمية التربية الأخلاقية للأبناء في الإسلام
review_defects.english: The Importance of Tarbiyah al-Akhlaqiyyah for Children in Islam
review_defects.why: The Arabic title uses ordinary words meaning 'moral upbringing'; transliterating them as 'Tarbiyah al-Akhlaqiyyah' leaves the title untranslated and is inconsistent with the body, where the same terms are translated as 'tarbiyah (upbringing)' and 'akhlaq (character)'.
